title: The role name cannot be left empty when editing
custom_steps:
1. Clear the Role name field.
  2. Try to Save.
custom_expected:
A message 'Role name is a required field' appears under the 'Role name*' label.

Save is blocked; the role cannot be saved with an empty name.
viu_status: Blocked-UI behavior; 'Role name*' + required-field message build-verified
evidence: 'Role name*' and '<field> is a required field' confirmed in build. Save-block needs live editor.
